import Payout.Spec
import Payout.Lemmas
namespace Payout
instance instDecidableValidPayout (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidPayout s r) := by
  unfold ValidPayout; infer_instance
def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if ValidPayout s r then
    (.ok, { s with
      balance := fun a => expectedBalance s r a,
      applied := r.txId :: s.applied })
  else (.rejected, s)
theorem req_valid_succeeds : ValidSucceeds step := sorry
theorem req_invalid_noop   : InvalidNoop step := sorry
theorem req_fair_shares    : FairShares step := sorry
theorem req_effects        : Effects step := sorry
theorem req_conservation   : Conserves step := sorry
theorem req_nonnegative    : NonNegative step := sorry
theorem req_authorization  : AuthorizedOnly step := sorry
theorem req_idempotency    : Idempotent step := sorry
end Payout

theorem sumConstRangePayout (n : Nat) (c : Int) : sumOver (List.range n) (fun _ => c) = (n : Int) * c := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have h1 : List.range (n+1) = List.range n ++ [n] := by simp [List.range_succ]
    rw [h1]
    have h2 : sumOver (List.range n ++ [n]) (fun _ => c) = sumOver (List.range n) (fun _ => c) + sumOver ([n] : List Nat) (fun _ => c) := by
      induction (List.range n) with
      | nil => simp
      | cons a t ih2 => simp only [List.cons_append, sumOver_cons, ih2]; omega
    rw [h2, ih]
    simp only [sumOver_cons, sumOver_nil]
    simp
